## TemplateEngine.\_PAGE\_ATTR\_VALUE\_VALIDATORS property

Attribute value validators for `<g-*>` PAGE blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS: Record<string, Record<string, (value: string) => string | null>>;
```

## Remarks

Per-tag, per-attribute map of validators. Each validator receives the raw attribute value (after quote-stripping) and returns either `null` (valid) or a descriptive error string. The value validation runs after the per-block attribute validation, so unknown attributes are reported separately by `validateBlockG*Attributes` methods.

Currently covers: - `<g-base id>` — must not be empty - `<g-keyboard type>` — must be `inline` or `bottom` - `<g-media type>` — must be one of: photo, video, audio, document, animation, voice, video\_note, sticker, location, contact - `<g-media shared>` — must be `true` or `false` - `<g-media filename>` — any string, always valid - `<g-poll type>` — must be `regular` or `quiz` - `<g-poll correct>` — must be a non-negative option index - `<g-poll explanation>` — any string, always valid - `<g-poll anonymous>` / `<g-poll multiple>` — must be `true` or `false` - `<g-venue title>` / `<g-venue address>` — any string, always valid - `<g-venue latitude>` — must be a number between -90 and 90; `{{}}` values skip the static check (runtime-enforced) - `<g-venue longitude>` — must be a number between -180 and 180; `{{}}` values skip the static check (runtime-enforced) - `<g-dice emoji>` — must be one of 🎲🎯🏀⚽🎳🎰; `{{}}` values skip the static check (runtime-enforced) - `<g-invoice currency>` — must be a 3-letter code (`XTR` or fiat); `{{}}` values skip the static check (runtime-enforced) - `<g-price amount>` — must be a positive integer in smallest currency units - `<g-paid-media stars>` — must be a positive integer 1–25000; `{{}}` values skip the static check (runtime-enforced)

Validators are intentionally lenient — they catch obvious bugs (wrong type, invalid value) but do not enforce every framework-level constraint.

## Example


```typescript
TemplateEngine._PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS["g-keyboard"].type("inline")   // => null
TemplateEngine._PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS["g-keyboard"].type("sidebar") // => "Attribute \"type\" on <g-keyboard> must be \"inline\" or \"bottom\", got \"sidebar\""
```
